one_liner: A configurable portal app that opens a URL (e.g., Google) with UI labels, audio, spatial sound, and particle effects.
primary_use_case: Warp users to external web destinations via an interactive 3D portal with customizable UI and audio.
preview_recommendation: Use the provided MP4 preview to showcase the portal’s UI and particle effects; ensure audio is enabled to hear the spatial music.
manifest_quality_notes: Script includes UI and particle logic
